'''Jarid DeBell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After serving the Order as a Knight for a few years, DeBell turned in his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and retired his rank, becoming an adviser within the Republic government. Working with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren]] of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], he eventually married her, and they gave birth to a daughter, [[Night Forael Wren]].

==Biography==
Discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] during his childhood, Jarid DeBell did not study at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] as did the vast majority of the Order's [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]]. Instead, DeBell was stationed at the [[Almas Academy|experimental]] [[Jedi academy|academy]] on [[Almas]], overseen by the headmaster, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]]. Within the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], DeBell's training was conducted first at the academy, then abroad during an apprenticeship with a Master. Eventually passing his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], DeBell was declared a Jedi Knight and given assignments by the [[Almas Council]].<ref name="AOE" />

While he served in this capacity for a few years, DeBell eventually concluded that the Jedi path was not for him after all. Turning in his lightsaber and robes to Master Qel-Bertuk, DeBell left the Order and traveled to Coruscant, where he began working as an envoy and adviser within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Hired by the newly elected [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren]] of the Cularin system, DeBell traveled between the stars on diplomatic errands, including a few brief forays into [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], which earned him the hatred of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. Following the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], DeBell was assigned by the Senate to act as an investigative envoy to the democratic monarchy as the government reestablished control over the world.<ref name="AOE" />

After years of work together, the relationship between Envoy DeBell and Senator Wren evolved, and the two eventually were to be wed. Before the wedding, DeBell partook in a stag night, during which he consumed large quantities of [[Ithorian brandy]] and [[Rodian ale]]. During the wedding, the assassin [[Melo Centris]], who had been hired by the Hutts, attempted to kill DeBell with a poisoned cake. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] were able to prevent this from happening. Surviving the assassination attempt, DeBell and Wren went on to have a daughter, whom they named [[Night Forael Wren]].<ref name="AOE" />
